examples.arabic: بالتأكيد، فوجود الانسجام بين العمل والحياة الشخصية أمر ضروري، أليس كذلك؟
examples.english: Absolutely, for the existence of harmony between work and personal life is a necessary matter, is it not?
examples.transliteration: Bit-ta'keed, fa-wujood al-insijam bayna al-'amal wa al-hayah ash-shakhsiyyah amr darooree, alaysa kadhalik?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: تبادلا همومهما اليومية وتحديات الحياة المعاصرة بصدق يثبت عمق علاقتهما الجوارية
examples.english: They genuinely exchanged their daily worries and the challenges of modern life, proving the depth of their neighborly relationship.
examples.transliteration: Tabādalā humoomahumā al-yawmiyyah wa tahaddiyāt al-hayāh al-mu'āsirah bisidqin yuthbit umq alāqatihimā al-jiwāriyyah.

examples.arabic: تحدثنا طويلا عن كيف تتطور الحياة وتصبح احيانا صعبة
examples.english: We talked a lot about how life develops and sometimes becomes difficult
examples.transliteration: tahaddathna taweelan an kayfa tatatawwaru alhayatu wa tusbihu ahyaanan saabatan
